claims.evidence_quote: We strongly encourage the continued funding of the E-Rate program. Removing this support would not move schools away from unnecessary technology spending—it would force schools to choose between maintaining essential infrastructure and funding other services that directly benefit students. The E-Rate program is an investment in our students, our teachers, our schools, and the infrastructure that allows modern public education to function. E-Rate should not be eliminated. It should be preserved and strengthened.
